# `aitbc pool-hub sla`

Monitor pool hub SLA status across miners.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc pool-hub sla [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--miner` | text | — | no | Show metric history for a specific miner |
| `--hours` | integer range | `24` | no | Metric history window in hours |
| `--violations` | flag | `false` | no | List SLA violations instead of the status summary |
| `--resolved` | flag | `false` | no | With --violations: list resolved violations (default lists open ones) |
| `--pool-id` | text | — | no | Specific pool ID |
| `--pool-hub-url` | text | — | no | Pool Hub service URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc pool-hub sla
```
